India Adjusts Taxes on Fuel Exports Amidst Crude Oil Price Fluctuations

The Indian government has modified taxes on petrol and diesel, notably increasing the windfall tax on the export of diesel and jet fuel. This decision comes in response to fluctuations in crude oil prices. The move aims to manage domestic fuel availability and potentially impact export revenues.
